title: Printed parts on drone models
goal: Drone models carry printed parts (name, aliases, count, side/variant, file, material, profile, spool); drones inherit them
acceptance: Store migration: drone model, printed part (count, variant such as left/right, file path, material, slicer profile, external spool flag); a drone links to its model
Fleet import (F-098-T05) and chat (F-098-T06) can add a model, its parts and link a drone; unknown profiles are refused against the F-087 allowlist
Neutral fixtures only; tests cover inheritance and a shared part (the same GPS/buzzer enclosure on two models)
Part files are stored as paths relative to the Mac's library folder (~/.nerv/prints); absolute paths, .. segments and links outside it are refused
A part can be one file holding several objects (AOS 5.1 camera bands: one file, both sides), so its count is per print, not per object
privacy: Neutral fixtures only; the owner's part list and file paths stay in private fleet data.
validation: node --test test/fleet-prints.test.ts test/fleet-chat.test.ts test/fleet.test.ts test/fleet-import.test.ts test/misato.test.ts test/slicer.test.ts test/cli-help.test.ts
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 at agent speed (3 h agent). Actual includes the print library resolver, the home slicer-profiles.json allowlist reader and the fleet models/prints CLI listings. Not a measurement.
